message.content:
The user wants to turn WiFi on. I can see the current screen is the Internet settings page in the Settings app. I can see there's a "Wi-Fi" option with a toggle switch that appears to be currently off (the toggle is on the right side and appears dark/disabled). 

Looking at the screen, I can see:
- Internet settings page
- T-Mobile (Mobile data won't auto-connect)
- Wi-Fi with a toggle switch that appears to be off
- AndroidWifi (Saved / No internet access)
- Network preferences
- Saved networks
- Non-carrier data usage

To turn WiFi on, I need to tap on the Wi-Fi toggle switch. The toggle appears to be located at approximately coordinates [846, 377] based on the layout.

Let me tap on the Wi-Fi toggle to turn it on.
do(action="Tap", element=[846,377])
